page.notes: Two lines are split at the hyphen across lines; the text runs on across them. The faint signature mark at the lower left (possibly "Cc 3") is too blurred to read with confidence, so it is left out. Show-through and stains are not transcribed. Printed u/v spellings were normalised as instructed: "vnicum" to "unicum", "vrget" to "urget", "vt" to "ut". Printing errors are kept as printed, for example "Reipub." and "denig.".
